restaurant.name: Brewberrys Cafe Jammu
restaurant.tagline: Specialty Brews, Monster Shakes & Youth Conversations
restaurant.subTagline: Jammu's quintessential youth coffee haven on Apsara Road — pour-overs, thick freak shakes, crispy sourdough melts, and late evening cafe banter.
restaurant.concept: Contemporary minimalist specialty coffee bar and vibrant hangout for Jammu's college youth, creative professionals, and coffee purists.

location.address: Opposite Apsara Multiplex, Near Gole Market, Apsara Road
location.landmarks: Directly opposite Apsara Road shopping promenade, 200m from Gole Market & Dudhadhari Temple turn

hours.happyHours: 4:00 PM – 6:30 PM (20% Off Cold Brews & Shakes)

amenities: Ultra High-Speed Gigabit Wi-Fi for Study & Work
Dedicated Laptop Friendly Power Plugs at Every Table
Curated Board Games Library (Catan, Scrabble, Chess)

marketAnalysis.locationContext: Apsara Road in Gandhi Nagar is the undisputed youth and fashion epicentre of Jammu. Flanked by high schools, colleges, coaching institutes, and Bahu Plaza commercial complex, it sees massive student and young professional footfall seeking stylish spaces to unwind.

targetDemographics.need: Affordable yet photogenic monster shakes, loaded peri-peri fries, and chilled study spots with strong Wi-Fi.
targetDemographics.vibeRequirement: Casual, zero-judgement lounge, low-stress ordering, energetic yet non-deafening music.

targetDemographics.need: Single-origin pour-overs, cold brew tonics, quiet daytime seating with power outlets, quick paninis.
targetDemographics.vibeRequirement: Clean minimalist aesthetic, fast Wi-Fi, professional hospitality.

targetDemographics.need: Crowd-pleasing freak shakes, shareable nachos, pizzas, celebratory cake plates with candle sparklers.
targetDemographics.vibeRequirement: Vibrant, Instagrammable lighting, comfortable booth seating.

culinaryPillars.description: 100% Arabica beans sourced from Chikmagalur estates, freshly ground per order for espresso, cold drip, aeropress, and velvety flat whites.
Indulgent glass jars crowned with whole brownies, toasted waffles, Nutella drizzles, and caramel popcorn.
Stone-pressed sourdough sandwiches stuffed with bocconcini, smoked chicken, chipotle paneer, and garlic herb butter.
Crispy peri-peri crinkle fries, layered nachos with salsa roja, hand-tossed thin crust pizzas, and hearty pasta bowls.

visualIdentity.designTheme: Appetizing Light Theme — Sunlit Buttermilk & Tangerine Flame
visualIdentity.aestheticPhilosophy: Vibrant, sunlit, appetizing youth cafe aesthetic. Warm buttermilk cream canvas (#FFFDF9), crisp pure white cards with soft peach borders (#F3E8E2), tangerine flame orange interactive accents (#EA580C), crema gold badges (#D97706), and deep roasted slate typography (#1C1917) for 100% WCAG AAA contrast.

primary.name: Tangerine Flame Orange
primary.description: Primary brand accent, used for interactive badges, highlights, prices, and CTAs

hero.headline: Specialty Brews & Youth Conversations in Gandhi Nagar
hero.subheadline: Crafted single-origin Arabica, skyscraper freak shakes, and toasted sourdough paninis on Apsara Road. Designed for slow sips, fast Wi-Fi, and late evening cafe memories.

highlights.title: Single-Origin Arabica
highlights.description: Estate-grade beans extracted with precision, from silky flat whites to 18-hour cold brew tonics.

highlights.title: Iconic Freak Shakes
highlights.description: Towering signature milkshakes layered with fudge brownies, Belgian chocolate, and crushed Biscoff.

highlights.title: Stone-Pressed Melts
highlights.description: Golden grilled sourdough paninis, loaded cheesy nachos, and hand-tossed thin crust pizzas.

items.name: Signature Irish Cold Coffee
items.description: Double espresso shot shaken with Irish cream extract, rich chilled dairy, and vanilla bean froth.
items.ingredients: Chikmagalur Arabica Double Shot, Non-alcoholic Irish Cream, Condensed Milk, Whole Milk, Cocoa Dust
items.pairing: Pairs perfectly with Truffle Cheese Fries or Nutella Croissant

items.name: Roasted Hazelnut Frappe
items.description: Slow-roasted Piedmont hazelnut puree blended with ice-cold espresso and topped with whipped mascarpone.
items.ingredients: Espresso Blend, Roasted Hazelnut Paste, Cream, Whipped Topping, Crushed Roasted Hazelnuts
items.pairing: Best savored with Classic Cheesy Garlic Bread

items.name: Himalayan Pour-Over (V60)
items.description: Hand-poured single origin filter brew highlighting notes of wild berries, raw cane sugar, and citrus zest.
items.ingredients: Light-Medium Roast Single Origin Arabica, Mineral Spring Water (200ml)
items.pairing: Excellent with Grilled Smoked Chicken Panini

items.name: Spanish Cortado Latte
items.description: Equal parts intense ristretto espresso and warm silky microfoam milk for a balanced, bold morning kick.
items.ingredients: Double Ristretto, Steamed Whole Milk, Microfoam
items.pairing: Try with Cinnamon Sugar Waffle Pop

items.name: Classic 18-Hour Cold Brew Tonic
items.description: Steeped cold for 18 hours in Jammu spring water, served over crystal clear ice with effervescent tonic and lime wheel.
items.ingredients: 18-Hour Arabica Cold Brew, Artisanal Indian Tonic Water, Rosemary Sprig, Dehydrated Lime
items.pairing: Complements Peri-Peri Crispy Paneer Burger

items.name: The Nutella Volcano Freak Shake
items.description: Thick Nutella milkshake rimmed with chocolate chips, crowned with a warm walnut brownie, chocolate wafer stick, and chocolate syringe.
items.ingredients: Pure Nutella, Chocolate Gelato, Whole Milk, Fresh Fudge Brownie, Wafer Roll, Chocolate Sauce
items.pairing: Must-have celebration shake for birthdays and reunions

items.name: Lotus Biscoff Crunch Shake
items.description: Caramelized Lotus Biscoff butter blended with vanilla bean cream, topped with crushed speculoos biscuits and salted caramel drizzle.
items.ingredients: Lotus Biscoff Spread, Speculoos Biscuits, Vanilla Custard Cream, Sea Salt Caramel
items.pairing: Pairs with Crispy Mexican Loaded Nachos

items.name: Belgian Dark Truffle Shake
items.description: Intense 70% dark Belgian cocoa melted into frozen cream, finished with bittersweet shaved chocolate curl rosettes.
items.ingredients: 70% Dark Callebaut Cocoa, Dark Ganache, Heavy Cream, Shaved Chocolate Flakes
items.pairing: Goes well with Smoked Chicken Smashed Burger

items.name: Kashmir Strawberry Velvet Shake
items.description: Fresh hill strawberry compote swirled with sweet cream, white chocolate drizzle, and strawberry pop crunch.
items.ingredients: Hill Strawberry Compote, White Chocolate Sauce, Whole Cream, Whipped Swirl
items.pairing: Pair with Four Cheese Garlic Pull-Apart Bread

items.name: Apsara Kaffir Lime & Mint Mojito
items.description: Muddled garden mint, kaffir lime zest, raw demerara sugar, sparkling club soda, and crushed glacier ice.
items.ingredients: Fresh Spearmint, Kaffir Lime Leaves, Demerara Sugar, Sparkling Soda, Crushed Ice
items.pairing: Light accompaniment to Truffle Fries

items.name: Jammu Wild Peach Iced Tea
items.description: Slow-brewed Assam black tea infused with natural peach nectar, citrus bitters, and fresh peach slices.
items.ingredients: Assam Orthodox Black Tea, Natural Peach Puree, Fresh Mint, Lemon Slices
items.pairing: Crisp pairing for Peri-Peri Chicken Pizza

items.name: Blue Curacao Citrus Fizz
items.description: Vibrant Caribbean blue citrus cordial charged with Sprite, lemon tang, and sparkling water.
items.ingredients: Blue Curacao Syrup (Non-Alcoholic), Sprite, Lemon Juice, Mint Leaves, Black Salt
items.pairing: Great with Spicy Farmhouse Pizza

items.name: Passion Fruit & Basil Cooler
items.description: Tropical passion fruit pulp shaken with fragrant sweet basil seeds, ginger hint, and chilled apple juice.
items.ingredients: Passion Fruit Pulp, Sweet Basil Seeds (Sabja), Clarified Apple Juice, Ginger Essence
items.pairing: Pairs with Pesto Mozzarella Panini

items.name: Peri-Peri Crispy Paneer Burger
items.description: Golden panko-crusted cottage cheese patty tossed in fiery peri-peri spices, layered with crunchy purple slaw, gherkins, and garlic aioli in toasted brioche.
items.ingredients: Fresh Malai Paneer, Panko Crust, In-House Peri Peri Spice, Red Cabbage Slaw, Garlic Mayo, Butter Brioche
items.pairing: Enjoy with Irish Cold Coffee

items.name: Smoked Chicken Smashed Burger
items.description: Double grilled minced chicken patties smashed on the griddle with cheddar cheese melt, caramelized balsamic onions, and smoky BBQ relish.
items.ingredients: Smoked Minced Chicken, English Cheddar, Caramelized Onions, Smoke Mayo, Brioche Bun
items.pairing: Pairs with Belgian Dark Truffle Shake

items.name: Pesto Sundried Tomato Panini
items.description: Fresh walnut basil pesto, buffalo mozzarella, sundried tomatoes, and balsamic reduction pressed crisp inside Italian focaccia.
items.ingredients: Fresh Basil Pesto, Buffalo Mozzarella, Sundried Tomatoes, Olive Oil Focaccia, Aged Balsamic
items.pairing: Wonderful with Himalayan Pour-Over

items.name: Barbecue Pulled Chicken Melt
items.description: Slow-braised pulled chicken tossed in hickory BBQ sauce, pressed between seeded sourdough with double melted Monterey Jack cheese.
items.ingredients: Pulled Herb Chicken, Hickory Smoke BBQ, Monterey Jack, Pickled Jalapeños, Artisan Sourdough
items.pairing: Great with Wild Peach Iced Tea

items.name: Gandhi Nagar Special Farmhouse Pizza
items.description: San Marzano marinara, 100% mozzarella, sweet corn, bell peppers, button mushrooms, black olives, and fresh red onions on thin crisp crust.
items.ingredients: Italian Plum Tomato Sauce, Fior Di Latte Mozzarella, Corn, Capsicum, Mushrooms, Olives, Oregano
items.pairing: Ideal for sharing with 2 iced lattes

items.name: Fiery Peri-Peri Pollo Pizza
items.description: Char-grilled peri-peri chicken chunks, spicy jalapeños, smoked paprika, roasted garlic, and stringy mozzarella.
items.ingredients: Spicy Peri Marinated Chicken, Jalapeños, Crushed Red Chilis, Mozzarella, Fresh Basil
items.pairing: Cools down with Kaffir Lime Mojito

items.name: Quattro Formaggi (Four Cheese) Pizza
items.description: A decadent molten blend of mozzarella, English cheddar, creamy gouda, and ricotta dollops with rosemary garlic honey drizzle.
items.ingredients: Mozzarella, Cheddar, Gouda, Whipped Ricotta, Rosemary Hot Honey
items.pairing: Pairs with Spanish Cortado Latte

items.name: Chipotle Paneer Tikka Pizza
items.description: Tandoori-spiced paneer cubes, roasted bell peppers, crunchy red onions, and smoky Mexican chipotle cream drizzle.
items.ingredients: Tandoori Paneer, Chipotle Crema, Red Capsicum, Onion, Mozzarella Cheese
items.pairing: Pairs with Roasted Hazelnut Frappe

items.name: Truffled Mushroom Alfredo Penne
items.description: Slow-simmered rich parmesan cream sauce, sautéed button mushrooms, white truffle oil mist, and fresh cracked black pepper.
items.ingredients: Durum Wheat Penne, Fresh Dairy Cream, Aged Parmesan, Sautéed Mushrooms, White Truffle Oil
items.pairing: Comes served with 2 slices of garlic baguette

items.name: Spicy Arrabbiata Grilled Chicken Fusilli
items.description: Zesty garlic-chili San Marzano tomato ragu tossed with spirals of fusilli pasta, tender grilled chicken breast, and kalamata olives.
items.ingredients: Italian Tomatoes, Fresh Garlic, Birds Eye Chili, Olive Oil, Herb-Grilled Chicken, Kalamata Olives
items.pairing: Pairs with Blue Curacao Citrus Fizz

items.name: Sun-Kissed Pink Sauce Penne
items.description: The golden union of fiery arrabbiata and velvety alfredo cream sauce, tossed with broccoli florets, baby corn, and mozzarella stretch.
items.ingredients: Mama Rosa Pink Sauce, Penne Rigate, Steamed Broccoli, Sweet Corn, Mozzarella Melt
items.pairing: Served with warm toasted garlic bread

items.name: Smoked Basil Pesto Chicken Penne
items.description: Aromatic Genovese basil pesto emulsion with roasted pine nuts, tender chicken strips, cherry tomatoes, and grated parmesan shavings.
items.ingredients: Genovese Basil Pesto, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Shredded Roast Chicken, Blistered Cherry Tomatoes, Parmesan
items.pairing: Pairs with Cold Brew Tonic

items.name: Overloaded Mexican Salsa Nachos
items.description: Crispy corn tortilla triangles layered with warm liquid cheddar cheese, freshly diced pico de gallo salsa, sliced jalapeños, and sour cream.
items.ingredients: Corn Tortilla Chips, Liquid Cheddar Sauce, Tomato Salsa Roja, Jalapeño Rings, Sour Cream
items.pairing: Perfect for table-side gaming and sharing

items.name: Cheesy Truffle Crinkle Fries
items.description: Crispy golden crinkle cut potato fries tossed in aromatic truffle salt, drizzled with warm molten cheese and fresh chopped parsley.
items.ingredients: Crinkle Cut Potatoes, Aromatic Truffle Essence, Melted Cheese Sauce, Paprika Dust, Parsley
items.pairing: Best companion with any brewberrys burger

items.name: Four Cheese Garlic Stuffed Bread
items.description: Freshly baked artisan baguette scored and packed with roasted garlic compound butter, parsley, and gooey mozzarella pull.
items.ingredients: Artisan French Loaf, Roasted Confit Garlic, Fresh Herbs Butter, Stretched Mozzarella
items.pairing: Dips effortlessly into pasta sauces

items.name: Crisp Belgian Nutella Waffle Pop
items.description: Freshly iron-pressed waffle pop on a wooden stick, drowned in warm Nutella, toasted almond flakes, and rainbow sprinkles.
items.ingredients: Belgian Waffle Batter, Pure Nutella, Roasted Flaked Almonds, Dark Chocolate Drizzle
items.pairing: End your coffee session on a sweet note

reviews.author: Aarav Sharma
reviews.text: Brewberrys on Apsara Road is our gang's permanent hangout spot. The Nutella Volcano Freak Shake is totally unmatched in Jammu, and the high-speed Wi-Fi makes it super easy to complete assignments while sipping an Irish Cold Coffee!

reviews.author: Mehak Jamwal
reviews.text: Easily the best specialty coffee aesthetic in town. No loud chaotic music, super sleek minimalist dark decor, and their V60 pour-over coffee actually has the floral notes they promise. Highly recommend the peri-peri burger!

reviews.author: Rohit Verma
reviews.text: Great spot for casual meetings and quick bites. The Truffle Cheese Fries and Pesto Panini are top tier. Their staff is polite, fast, and the Apsara Road location is super convenient.
